pattern_explanation: The Turkish word in this set looks almost identical to an English word that means something different. Learners who translate it by sight will choose the wrong English word, so the match must be learned from its meaning, not its spelling.
false_friend_warning: The Turkish word transliterated as 'kondisyon' looks like the English word 'condition', but it means physical fitness. Students should not translate it as 'condition', which is a false friend.
